text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia to celebrate Eid al-Adha on April 17.
- President Ben Ali on Tuesday instructed Finance Minister Mohamed Jeri to continue efforts on curbing expenses in the 1998 budget to reach financial balance.
- Parliament on Tuesday adopted a law allowing all insurance companies to insure exports.
- Tunisian official pilgrims delegation leaves for Jeddah.
- End of consultation with political parties and professional organisations over the final draft of the 9th development plan 1997-2001. The high planning committee is to meet on Saturday.
- Saudi Prince al-Waleed bin Talal looks at investing in Tunisian agriculture, hotels.
